description.value: Mr. Pretzels is a global soft-pretzel franchise founded in Puerto Rico in 1994, operating kiosk-style in shopping centres worldwide. The Victoria location on Douglas Street offers freshly hand-rolled pretzels baked on the spot in sweet and savoury flavours including cinnamon sugar, chocolate, salted, sesame seed, and pretzel dogs. It is a quick, portable snack stop well placed in downtown Victoria for cyclists passing through.
